nodes.description: IERC20 immutable _token held by the SupervisedTimelock contract
address immutable _beneficiary that receives released tokens
uint256 immutable _releaseStartTime, start of the vesting window
uint256 _releaseEndTime, end of the vesting window; rewritten by terminate()
uint256 _totalBenefit, total amount of benefit held for the beneficiary
uint256 _withdrawedBalance, amount already withdrawn by the beneficiary
bool _isTerminated flag guarding terminate() via isNotTerminated
address private _owner from Ownable
SupervisedTimelock constructor: initializes token, beneficiary, release window and total benefit
withdraw(): computes released minus withdrawn and transfers tokens to the beneficiary
terminate(): onlyOwner/isNotTerminated, cuts the vesting window and sends unreleased funds to the owner
releasedBalance(): view, linearly releases benefit based on block.timestamp vs release window
unreleasedBalance(): view returning _totalBenefit - releasedBalance()
withdrawedBalance(): view returning _withdrawedBalance
token(): view returning the held IERC20
beneficiary(): view returning the beneficiary address
totalBenefit(): view returning _totalBenefit
owner(): view from Ownable returning _owner
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner, sets owner to address(0)
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner, sets a new owner
_setOwner(address): internal state transition that writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred
onlyOwner modifier: requires owner() == _msgSender()
isNotTerminated modifier: requires _isTerminated == false
msg.sender, attacker-influenced caller address (via _msgSender), compared against owner and used to set the initial owner
block.timestamp, miner-influenced time used to derive the release window and terminate the vesting
token().safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) inside withdraw(): external token call performed after balance accounting
token().safeTransfer(owner(), amountToWithdraw) inside terminate(): external token call sending funds to the owner
token().balanceOf(address(this)) - (_totalBenefit - _withdrawedBalance) inside terminate(): subtraction that can underflow/revert on inconsistent token balances
(_totalBenefit * passedDays) / totalDays computed from block.timestamp inside releasedBalance(): timestamp-dependent vesting arithmetic
constructor parameter token_ (IERC20)
constructor parameter beneficiary_ (address)
constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ (uint256), rounded down to a day
constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ (uint256)
constructor parameter totalBenefit_ (uint256)
transferOwnership parameter newOwner (address)
withdraw() local uint256 amount = releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance
terminate() local uint256 amountToWithdraw = token balance - unreleased amount
releasedBalance() local uint256 passedDays = (block.timestamp - _releaseStartTime) / 86400
releasedBalance() local uint256 totalDays = (_releaseEndTime - _releaseStartTime) / 86400
_setOwner() local address oldOwner = _owner, used for the OwnershipTransferred event

edges.reason: constructor assigns parameter token_ to the immutable state variable _token
constructor assigns parameter beneficiary_ to the immutable state variable _beneficiary
constructor rounds releaseStartTime_ down to a full day and stores it in _releaseStartTime
_releaseEndTime is derived from releaseStartTime_ plus the timelock duration
daysOfTimelock_ multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY determines _releaseEndTime
constructor assigns parameter totalBenefit_ to _totalBenefit
constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, tying contract validity to a miner-influenced value
constructor initializes _withdrawedBalance to zero
constructor initializes the _isTerminated flag to false
constructor forwards _msgSender() (msg.sender) through _setOwner, making the deployer the owner
constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()) during deployment
releasedBalance() reads _releaseStartTime to compute elapsed days
releasedBalance() reads _releaseEndTime to determine the vesting window
releasedBalance() scales _totalBenefit by the passed fraction of the window
releasedBalance() branches on block.timestamp, making the withdrawable amount miner-influenceable
releasedBalance() performs (_totalBenefit * passedDays) / totalDays, a multiplication/division that can overflow or truncate
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit
unreleasedBalance() depends on releasedBalance(); if releases exceeded _totalBenefit the subtraction underflows
withdrawedBalance() returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable
token() returns the _token state variable
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable
totalBenefit() returns the _totalBenefit state variable
owner() returns the _owner state variable
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with _msgSender() before allowing the function body
onlyOwner relies on msg.sender (_msgSender) for authorization; spoofable in meta-transaction setups
isNotTerminated modifier gates execution on the _isTerminated state flag
withdraw() calls releasedBalance() to determine the currently claimable amount
withdraw() reads _withdrawedBalance to compute the delta and to update the accounting
local amount is derived from releasedBalance() in withdraw()
local amount = releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance can underflow if accounting is inconsistent
withdraw() adds amount to _withdrawedBalance before transferring tokens
withdraw() passes the local amount into token().safeTransfer
withdraw() uses the token() state variable for the safeTransfer call
withdraw() sends the tokens to the immutable _beneficiary address
withdraw() executes the external safeTransfer call at the end of its body
safeTransfer invokes the untrusted token contract, which can call back into withdraw() and re-enter with stale releasedBalance()/_withdrawedBalance values
terminate() is protected by the onlyOwner modifier
terminate() is additionally protected by isNotTerminated; after the first call the flag blocks re-execution
terminate() calls releasedBalance() to freeze the benefit at its current vesting level
terminate() overwrites _totalBenefit with releasedBalance()
terminate() derives the frozen release window from block.timestamp
terminate() sets _isTerminated = true
terminate() reads token().balanceOf(address(this)) as the left operand of the subtraction
_totalBenefit participates in the (balance - (_totalBenefit - _withdrawedBalance)) subtraction that can underflow
_withdrawedBalance participates in the terminate() subtraction; stale values can drive the result negative
the subtraction result is stored in local amountToWithdraw
terminate() passes amountToWithdraw into token().safeTransfer
terminate() sends the residual tokens to owner(), the privileged address
terminate() performs the external safeTransfer call to the owner at the end of its body
the safeTransfer in terminate() hands control to the token contract, which could re-enter terminate()/withdraw() before the state settles
transferOwnership() takes the newOwner parameter and forwards it to _setOwner
transferOwnership() calls the internal _setOwner()
renounceOwnership() calls _setOwner(address(0))
_setOwner() receives newOwner and assigns it to the _owner store
transferOwnership()/constructor ultimately overwrite the privileged _owner reference
_setOwner() reads the current _owner into the oldOwner local
_setOwner() copies _owner into the local oldOwner for the event
the oldOwner local is used in the OwnershipTransferred event emitted by _setOwner()

terminate() local amountToWithdraw feeds token().safeTransfer; fold it into the safeTransfer unsafe_operation
